{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate for email
total_email = df[df['channel'] == 'email'].shape[0]
converted_email = df[df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
conv_rate_email = converted_email / total_email

# Compute conversion rate for paid_search
total_paid_search = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0]
converted_paid_search = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()
conv_rate_paid_search = converted_paid_search / total_paid_search

# Compute the difference in conversion rates
difference = conv_rate_email - conv_rate_paid_search

# Print the results
print(f"Conversion rate for email: {conv_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate for paid search: {conv_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
